strings: In distress, m_c calls to r_c0 hoping for an explanation for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hindpaws' failure to respond. After a bit of talking, it's determined that the paralysis should only be temporary.
While m_c admits that the break is nice, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} a little bit anxious about the fact {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs refuse to respond.
m_c complains about the fact that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs haven't been responding as much as usual recently, to the point it appears {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} an episode of paralysis.
